about_the_game:
🏹 Game Overview

Although this is an indie game, it features 100% full Korean voice acting.

Cute Warrior Girl 3 is a single-player RPG that combines comedy and fantasy elements.
Players take on the role of Fiora, a cute and brave warrior on a journey to protect her village.

The game maintains the humorous tone and simple controls of the previous title while adopting a traditional JRPG style.
It offers more events and character interactions, delivering a short but focused gameplay experience full of exploration, battles, and comedic scenes.

🧭 Story

A strange orc army suddenly appears in a peaceful village. Cute warrior Fiora sets out on a journey, exploring dangerous areas, meeting various NPCs, and advancing toward the orcs’ stronghold.
Unexpected and funny events await the player along the way.

Your ultimate goal is to gather information and combat techniques by talking to NPCs, earn GOLD through various events, buy and equip all gear, and defeat the orcs to protect the kingdom’s peace.
Can Fiora defeat the orcs?

⚔️ Key Features

  • 🕹️ Simple controls and turn-based combat: Easy and accessible for beginners

  • 🌿 Light exploration and interaction: Events occur in villages, forests, bathhouses, and more

  • 🎭 Comedic presentation: Cute SD characters and humorous situational scenes

  • 🧍‍♀️ Charming protagonist Fiora: Improved illustrations, expressions, and costumes

  • 🕰️ Short and focused gameplay: Approximately 30 minutes to complete

  • 🎧 BGM & Voice Acting: 100% Korean voice acting and subtitles (currently only Korean supported)

👉 If more than 3 requests for English support are made in the game’s review section, English subtitles will be added.

🧭 Controls

  • Move: Arrow Keys (↑ ↓ ← →)

  • Interact: Spacebar

  • Run: Left Shift Key

short_description: This is the adventure story of Fiora, the 21-year-old cute warrior girl. A sexy comedy JRPG where you explore the forest, talk with people to gather information about the orcs, and journey to their stronghold to defeat them!
